description: Use when preparing for Japan's Real Estate Transaction Specialist examination (宅地建物取引士試験 / 宅建) — the 50-question format, the four areas (権利関係・法令上の制限・税その他・宅建業法), the relative passing line, studying statutes in force on the exam's reference date, and drilling past questions. Also use when writing or verifying practice questions grounded in the Civil Code, the Real Estate Brokerage Act and land-use laws.
